module_summary: Wishbone-slave I2C master: a 4-register 16-bit bank (status, command, data, prescale) pushes commands and write bytes into AXI-stream FIFOs feeding an i2c_master core and pops read bytes from a read FIFO.

anchors.name: wbs_adr_i
anchors.why: Wishbone register address selecting status, command, data or prescale register.

anchors.name: wbs_stb_i
anchors.why: Wishbone strobe with cyc starts a register read or write cycle.

anchors.name: wbs_ack_o
anchors.why: Registered Wishbone acknowledge, also suppresses duplicate FIFO pushes.

anchors.name: wbs_dat_i
anchors.why: Write data loading command bits, data byte, prescale and clear flags.

anchors.name: wbs_dat_o
anchors.why: Registered read data muxed from status, command, read FIFO or prescale.

anchors.name: wbs_we_i
anchors.why: Selects register write versus read cycle.

anchors.name: cmd_address_reg
anchors.why: Software-written I2C target address pushed with command bits into command FIFO.

anchors.name: cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pushes command word into command FIFO after command register write.

anchors.name: data_in_reg
anchors.why: Write byte from data register pushed into write FIFO.

anchors.name: data_in_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pushes write byte into write data FIFO.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Read FIFO output byte returned on data register reads.

anchors.name: prescale_reg
anchors.why: Programmable SCL prescale fed to i2c_master timing.

anchors.name: wbs_cyc_i
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle qualifier combined with strobe.

anchors.name: cmd_read_reg
anchors.why: Representative command bit (start/read/write/write_multiple/stop) written by software.

anchors.name: data_in_last_reg
anchors.why: Last-byte flag for block write, pushed as tlast into write FIFO.

anchors.name: cmd_ready
anchors.why: Command FIFO ready; low indicates full and flags overflow.

anchors.name: data_in_ready
anchors.why: Write FIFO ready; low sets write overflow.

anchors.name: data_out_valid
anchors.why: Read FIFO has data; reported in data register and gates pop.

anchors.name: data_out_ready_reg
anchors.why: Pops read FIFO on data register read.

anchors.name: cmd_valid_int
anchors.why: Command FIFO output valid into i2c_master command interface.

anchors.name: missed_ack_reg
anchors.why: Sticky missed-ACK status bit, write 1 to clear.

anchors.name: cmd_fifo_overflow_reg
anchors.why: Sticky command FIFO overflow status bit.

anchors.name: write_fifo_overflow_reg
anchors.why: Sticky write FIFO overflow status bit.

anchors.name: busy_int
anchors.why: i2c_master busy reported in status register bit 0.

groups.name: wishbone_register_access
groups.description: Decodes Wishbone cycles to register reads/writes and registers ack and read data.

groups.name: command_register
groups.description: Command address and opcode bits pushed as one word into command FIFO.

groups.name: command_fifo
groups.description: Queues I2C commands for the i2c_master core.

groups.name: write_data_fifo
groups.description: Queues write bytes with last flag for the I2C core.

groups.name: read_data_fifo
groups.description: Buffers received I2C bytes popped by data register reads.

groups.name: status_config
groups.description: Prescale configuration and sticky status/overflow flags.

groups.name: i2c_core
groups.description: i2c_master engine executing queued commands on SCL/SDA.
